outline:
EMI Course (全英語授課): All class material will be delivered in English. All submitted works and presentation shall be in English as well.
This course covers the basics of publication editing, helping students develop practical layout skills. Through hands-on projects like posters, magazines, book covers, or/ and packaging, students will practice key design principles—including the Golden Ratio, the Van de Graaf Canon, Juxtaposition, and Narrative Form—to achieve effective visual and information communication.
課程將以介紹圖文編輯基礎在實務編排中學習掌握排版編輯之能力。課程將以數個編排技巧為基礎如Golden Ration、The Van de Graaf Cannon、Jaxtaposition、Narrative Form 等操作練習包含數位簡章、數位雜誌、及數位書籍或包裝等，藉由練習達到視覺及資訊傳達之目的。
